entry.notRun: no real runtime or store; the daemon client is the service called in-process
entry.runs: apps/desktop/src/main/session-host.ts SessionHost (setVisibleSessions, submitToSession, prefetchSession, subscribeSessionStates) over the real createSessionService (idle eviction sweep, handleCall session.*) with a scripted stored session and runtime, node:test mock timers, the read-diagnostics sink

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.entry: mixdog-core-session + mixdog-app-server (session host re-entry): replay each step list on a virtual clock (mock timers: Date, setInterval, setTimeout from 1_800_000_000_000; tick values are in the step labels); compare published texts, service size, stored read count and diagnostics records after each step

normalised.clock: mock timers, not the shared fixed Date.now
normalised.dataDir: temp user-data dir not in the recording
